events.description: Called with the new state each time the overlay opens or closes, from its trigger, a dismissal or the app.
events.name: onOpenChange

events.description:
The drawer's primary action, run by `confirmShortcut` (Mod+Enter by default) while it is the topmost overlay. Page
shortcuts pause while any drawer is open (ADR 0508). Web only today.
events.name: onConfirm

props.description: The sheet's parts, usually a header, a body and a footer; any element is allowed.
props.name: children

props.description:
The element that opens the sheet when pressed: a Button, or any pressable element. Leave it out for a sheet the
app opens through `isOpen`. Focus returns to it when the sheet closes.
props.name: trigger

props.description: The edge it comes from: `bottom` (the default), `top`, or `start` and `end` by reading direction.
props.name: placement

props.description:
The partial sizes it rests at, smallest first: pixels (points on native) or a share as `"50%"`. It opens at the
first, a swipe moves through them (several in one swipe) and the full size is always the last stop, so it is not
listed.
props.name: snapPoints

props.description:
True, the default, to close on a press outside, Escape or a swipe away. False keeps it open until a close control
inside it is pressed.
props.name: isDismissable

props.description: The backdrop's look: `opaque` (the default), `blur` or `transparent`.
props.name: backdrop

props.description:
True to float the sheet clear of the screen's edges with every corner rounded. Defaults to false on web and true
on native (every native sheet is inset, owner decision 2026-10-24).
props.name: isDetached

props.description: The accessible name for a sheet that has no `Sheet.Title`; with a title, the title names it.
props.name: label

props.description: The open state, for a controlled overlay; pair it with `onOpenChange`.
props.name: isOpen

props.description: The starting open state, for an uncontrolled overlay. Native's own name for it is `isDefaultOpen`.
props.name: defaultOpen

props.description: The binding of `onConfirm`. Defaults to `mod+enter`.
props.name: confirmShortcut

props.description: Animation configuration
props.name: animation

props.description: Additional CSS class for the background
props.name: backgroundClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the bottom sheet
props.name: className

props.description: Additional CSS class for the container
props.name: containerClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the content container
props.name: contentContainerClassName

props.description: Props for the content container
props.name: contentContainerProps

props.description: Additional CSS class for the handle
props.name: handleClassName

props.description: Additional CSS class for the handle indicator
props.name: handleIndicatorClassName

props.description:
View style to be applied to the sheet container component,
it also could be an Animated Style.
props.name: style
